grammar_focus: 被动语态复习(the passive,复习 KS10/21/34)主考——各时态被动(was/were done 一般过去、had been done 过去完成)、情态被动 must be done / must have been done(对过去推测)、主动↔被动转换、by 引出执行者;while + doing(在…时)、in time(最后终于)、a large sum of / in this way(辅考·课文①类)。美语差:百分之 美语拼 percent(一个词),英式 per cent(见关6对照)
scene: 整个村子很快知道有一大笔钱丢失了。当地的屠户萨姆·本顿在把存款送往邮局的途中把钱包丢了。萨姆确信那钱包一定被某个村民捡到了,可是却一直不见有人来送还他。3个月过去了,后来一天早晨,萨姆在自己的大门外发现了他的钱包:钱包用报纸包着,里面有他丢失的钱的一半,还附着一张纸条,上面写着:“一个小偷,是的,但只是一个50%的小偷!”又过了两个月,又有一些钱送还给萨姆,又附了一张字条:“这回只是25%的小偷了!”很快,萨姆全部的钱都用同样的方式还了回来。最后那张字条上写道:“我现在是一个100%的诚实人了!”

grammar_card.title: 被动语态复习:各时态 + 情态被动
grammar_card.intro: 被动语态 = be + 过去分词,表示'被…'。复习各时态:一般过去 was/were done、过去完成 had been done;情态被动 must be done / must have been done(对过去的推测)。动作的执行者用 by 引出。全用本课和 Key structures 的句子举例。

rows: This bridge was built in 1942.(桥被建造)
The thief was arrested by the police.(被警察抓)
The parcel had been sent to the wrong address.(被寄错)
情态 + 被动(对过去推测)
It must have been stolen.(一定被偷了)
This must be paid for.(必须被付款)

specialRules.rule: 对过去的推测用 must have been + 过去分词:The wallet must have been found(钱包一定被捡到了)。
被动句里动作的执行者用 by 引出:was arrested by the police。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How did Sam get his money back?
options: The thief returned it bit by bit, wrapped in newspaper with notes
A villager confessed and repaid him
He was refunded by the post office

passage: The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost. Sam Benton, the local butcher, had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office. Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers, but it was not returned to him. Three months passed, and then one morning, Sam found his wallet outside his front door. It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost, together with a note which said: 'A thief, yes, but only 50 percent a thief!' Two months later, some more money was sent to Sam with another note: 'Only 25 percent a thief now!' In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way. The last note said: 'I am 100 percent honest now!'
